notes:
ScreenTale 1.19.0 adds right-click menus to the Editor Timeline and makes Timeline editing smoother.

- Right-click (or Control-click) a clip, Zoom, annotation, mark or empty track to act on it directly: copy, paste, duplicate, split, group or ungroup clips, change Video speed, Camera layout and visibility, Zoom level and cursor following, move an annotation to another layer, lock a layer, or add a Zoom, annotation or mark at the clicked time.
- Dragging inside a multi-selection now moves the whole selection, even when you grab a clip's edge, and holding the selection key while dragging adds the clip to the selection.
- You can start the next drag while the previous edit is still being applied.
- Zooming the Timeline no longer regenerates its thumbnails, and selecting a Zoom no longer pauses editing.
- Save As…, Export…, Playback and Reset to Original… now live in the File menu and in the open recording's Library row menu.
- The Timeline no longer shows hover previews; scrubbing shows the edited frame in the main Preview instead.
- Saving or opening a dialog no longer shows a false "Could not apply the edit" notice.
